description: Replicating a history long enough for its array list to grow to three levels, with a failed transaction every so often and a slice that rolls the history back. The first sync replaces the replica, and the others only send what's new. Then a compacted copy of the source, which is a new file, gets a replica of its own. Written by src/longscripts.zig.

ops.note: even a new database can be sent
it can be opened as a database of its own
from what the slice took back
and it can keep receiving transactions
